assessmentType: Further bounded follow-up of the same simulated perspective; not a new independent human or blinded assessment
assessmentSubject: Locally repaired v0.9.3 classification pipeline. This score is not a certification of the superseded deployed candidate or a claim that repaired v0.9.3 is currently public.

evidenceInspected.observation: Curated resource recognition requires a registry match on id, source URL and title plus matching classification fields. A normalized record with publisher metadata cannot qualify as a curated resource solely because it carries reviewed-looking classifications or a provider string.

Final three tests check repeat normalization preserving metadata level/arrangement/mandatory review, rejection of forged provider-based provenance, and repeat preservation of genuine curated learning metadata.

Ten checks include three successive normalizations, unchanged provenance, full-time arrangement, mandatory full review, unknown eligibility, a positive job/full-time filter, a negative part-time filter, forged-provider rejection and genuine curated learning.

Retained real failure: first normalization reports job/full-time at level 2 publisher metadata; second reports job/unknown arrangement at level 1 source-reviewed. Applicant eligibility remains null and mandatory review remains true in the retained failure, so the receipt does not show a false applicant eligibility approval.
Supplied local browser receipt records ten passing assertions.
Supplied positive UI receipt contains the actual auditor card, job classification, full-time arrangement, level 2 publisher metadata, unknown eligibility and mandatory substantive source inspection.
Receipt records successful build/deploy of stable revision 79ceb6a4346c2c50d92d8c87a25fea3ef6f1cce6. This establishes the recorded rollback CI result, not repaired-v0.9.3 deployment parity.

failureAssessment: This was a substantive functional and provenance defect, not merely a cosmetic label: repeated normalization overstated the evidence tier and lost a known arrangement, causing a valid job/full-time record to disappear from a matching filter. Earlier broad pass counts did not cover this positive repeated-normalization path. The original technical-confidence language therefore needs this explicit qualification. There is no evidence in the supplied failure of applicant eligibility being approved.
repairAssessment: The inspected registry guard closes the identified provenance promotion route. Independent targeted execution confirms stable level 2 publisher metadata/full-time arrangement across repeats, a retained matching job/full-time record, mandatory full-source review and null applicant eligibility. Genuine curated learning still survives. This is bounded evidence for the identified path, not universal proof against provenance errors or arbitrary external-data authentication.

scoreRationale.B_Usefulness: Remains 7/10 for the locally repaired artifact. The real filter failure reduces confidence in prior coverage, but this specific defect now has a positive-path regression and an observed local UI receipt. The principal remaining deductions are still unmeasured learner/advisor usefulness and reading burden.
scoreRationale.H_Measurement: Remains 7/10. The retained adverse receipt, rollback and added cross-normalization/positive-filter controls improve the engineering measurement discipline after exposing a concrete gap. They neither erase the failure nor add independent accuracy or human outcome evidence. These developments change the qualification within the existing score band, rather than justify a whole criterion point in either direction.
